top_signals.title: Emerging-Market Stock Valuations Sink Below Half of S&P 500’s
top_signals.summary: For the first time in at least two decades, emerging-market stock valuations have fallen to less than half those of US equities, a sign to some investors that there are increasingly attractive opportunities in developing economies.
